A1-01.ko: 바늘 찔러 저주 · 헝겊 몸이 푹 꺼짐
A1-01.atk: a stitched rag doll jerks forward: a dry burlap rustle, a rusty pin jabbed in with a tiny prick, a drop of blood sizzling on a wax seal as the curse lands
A1-01.def: the limp cloth body crumples: a soft stuffing crunch, loose pins tinkling onto stone, a popped stitch, then a creak of thread as it sits back up

A1-02.atk: a fast swish of silk-like darkness snatches at the foe, a quick tearing rip as a shadow is peeled away, then a light, sly tap and a vanishing hiss
A1-02.def: no real block, it dodges: a puff of smoke dissolving, soft light footfalls skittering sideways, the blow only whooshing through empty air

A1-04.ko: 박쥐 떼 몰려 물어뜯음 · 떼가 흩어졌다 모임
A1-04.atk: a cloud of bats bursts off a ceiling: a rush of leathery wing flutter, shrill squeaks, then a flurry of tiny wet nips and a quick sucking hiss
A1-04.def: the swarm scatters at the blow: a burst of panicked flapping, a few thin squeals, the air whirring as the bats swirl back together

A1-05.ko: 갈퀴 손톱 할퀴고 물기 · 마른 시체가 퍽 꺾임
A1-05.atk: a hunched ghoul scrabbles forward on all fours: a ragged snarl, cracked nails raking with a dry scrape, then a wet gnawing bite
A1-05.def: no armour, dead grey flesh takes it: a dull leathery thud, a brittle bone crack, a hiss through broken teeth as it crouches lower

A1-06.ko: 납작한 그림자가 덮침 · 찢긴 가장자리로 스르르 흩어짐
A1-06.atk: a flat shadow peels off the ground with a papery rustle, slides up like spilled ink, then wraps the target in a cold whispering hiss and a soft muffled clap
A1-06.def: the blow passes through a flat silhouette: a faint tearing of frayed edges, a dry papery flap, the shadow flattening back onto stone with a hush

A1-07.ko: 적의 모습 흉내 내 베기 · 몸이 일렁이며 흘림
A1-07.atk: wet flesh ripples and stretches into the foe's shape with a warbling mirrored echo, then the copied blade slashes back with a hollow doubled clang
A1-07.def: the struck body wobbles like warm wax: a soft squelching ripple, a smeared mirror warble, the shape sliding half-loose then snapping back

A1-08.ko: 꿈결 속삭임에 저울 낙인 · 박쥐 날개로 감쌈
A1-08.atk: a silky laugh and a whisper of bat wings, a quill scratches a quick signature, then a scale-shaped brand sears on with a soft sizzling kiss
A1-08.def: thin bat wings fold in front of her: a leathery membrane snap, a velvet rustle, a breathy hiss as the hit glances off

A1-09.ko: 그림자 줄 쏘고 송곳니 · 다리 오므려 껍질로 받음
A1-09.atk: eight legs skitter on rock with dry clicks, a line of shadow silk zips out, then twin fangs sink in with a wet crunch and a venom hiss
A1-09.def: the spider pulls its legs in tight: a glossy chitin knock, a creak of jointed legs, sticky strands stretching and twanging around it

A1-11.ko: 마족 장검 내리침 · 투박한 갑옷이 둔탁히 받음
A1-11.atk: a rasping demon grunt as a crude iron blade is hauled up, a heavy downward whoosh, then a solid metallic chop with a short sting of sparks
A1-11.def: a plain iron breastplate takes it: a dull metallic bong, leather straps creaking, a low guttural huff as it digs its boots into dirt

A1-13.ko: 목 없는 기사 도끼로 빼앗아 냄 · 빈 갑주가 텅 울림
A1-13.atk: a held helm laughs dryly, ghost-flame roars from the empty neck, then an executioner's axe chops through with a heavy chunk and a quick yank as something is snatched away
A1-13.def: black plate takes the blow: a hollow booming clang from a headless suit, the ledger chain rattling, violet neck flame guttering with a whoosh

A1-15.ko: 홀로 날아든 칼이 피를 마심 · 칼날이 울며 쳐냄
A1-15.atk: a lone floating sword hums hungrily, whips through the air with a thin whine, then bites in with a wet slurping hiss as the steel drinks
A1-15.def: the blade spins edge-on to meet the strike: a sharp steel ring, a low moaning vibration in the metal, a few red drops pattering off

A1-17.atk: a cold breath draws in, then a piercing keening wail rises and cracks like glass, echoing off canyon walls in fading ghostly tails
A1-17.def: the strike tears through a misty gown: a fluttering rag whisper, a hollow sob, mist hissing back together

A1-18.ko: 그림자 짐승이 덮쳐 물어뜯음 · 연기 털이 흩어짐
A1-18.atk: a low rumbling growl in the dark, a padded lunge, then huge jaws snap shut with a crunching bite and a smoky snarl
A1-18.def: a body of black smoke fur takes the hit: a dull padded thump, a hiss of scattering smoke, a growl as the shape reforms

A1-21.atk: a long tail slithers over stone with a dry scale rasp, coils tighten with a creaking squeeze, then fangs strike with a sharp hiss and a wet puncture
A1-21.def: dark scales turn the blow: a slick glancing scrape, a coiled tail flexing with a heavy rustle, an angry rattling hiss

A1-23.ko: 낫이 서명만 남기고 베어냄 · 뼈 손이 낫자루로 받음
A1-23.atk: a long scythe swings in a wide cold arc: a hollow robe flap, a deep whoosh, a clean slicing hiss, then a dry quill scratch as only a signature is left
A1-23.def: bony hands raise the scythe shaft: a hard wooden knock, a rattle of bones under the robe, a chained ledger swinging and thumping

A1-24.ko: 발톱 할퀴고 물어뜯음 · 두꺼운 털가죽이 받음
A1-24.atk: a guttural snarl breaks into a short howl, heavy paws pound, then claws rake with a tearing rip and a crunching bite
A1-24.def: thick matted fur soaks the hit: a heavy hide thump, a pained growl, claws scraping the ground as it braces

A1-25.ko: 세 머리가 차례로 물어뜯음 · 쇠목걸이가 덜걱
A1-25.atk: three throats bark in a staggered volley, chains snap taut, then three sets of jaws crunch down one after another with ember sizzles
A1-25.def: spiked iron collars take the blow: a heavy clank, a jangle of broken chain, three snarls overlapping into a low rumble

A1-27.ko: 문서고 열쇠 돌려 피 창 꿰뚫음 · 피 막이 퍼짐
A1-27.atk: a heavy key turns in a rusty vault lock, drawers slam, then a spear of congealed blood shrieks through the air and punches through with a thick wet bore-through
A1-27.def: a curtain of blood falls like a sheet: a wide wet slap, slow thick dripping, a deep soft thud as the hit is smothered in crimson

A1-28.ko: 두루마리가 휘감아 내리찍음 · 종이가 찢기지 않고 튕김
A1-28.atk: a huge scroll unrolls with a loud paper snap, its edges curl and lash like whips, then wax seals crack and a splash of red ink stamps down
A1-28.def: a blade bites into thick parchment and will not cut: a stiff paper thwack, a creak of the roll, the edge springing back with a dry rustle

A1-29.ko: 등불 꺼뜨리며 걷는 거구 · 두터운 그림자 살갗
A1-29.atk: a heavy stomp, a row of lanterns blowing out with soft clicks, then a deep darkness slams in with a bone-shaking boom and a long sinking rumble
A1-29.def: a rippling shadow hide absorbs the blow: a deep booming thud, wings flapping heavily, a low resonant groan rolling out

A1-30.ko: 주인 없는 칼의 일섬 · 칼등이 침묵 속에 받음
A1-30.atk: dead stillness, then the wielderless blade draws itself: a hair-thin whistle of steel and one clean cut that leaves a ringing quiet behind
A1-30.def: the floating blade turns upright to meet the strike: a deep dense steel ring-out, a long vibrating overtone, then dead silence

A1-31.ko: 잔 부딪히고 핏빛 칼 관통 · 우아한 장막이 막음
A1-31.atk: crystal goblets clink, a thin rapier of dark red steel rings out, then a refined, clean pierce runs through with a short wet pop and a silk-like trail
A1-31.def: a velvet cloak swirls in front: a heavy cloth whump, a glass goblet shattering, a thick blood-ward pulse humming under the fabric

A1-32.ko: 저주 불꽃 주문 퍼부음 · 뼈 몸이 마른 소리로 받음
A1-32.atk: dry bones creak as a skeletal hand rises, a hollow dark drone swells through ancient stone, then a gout of violet curse fire roars out and splashes with a sizzle
A1-32.def: the blow cracks against yellowed bone under rotted robes: a brittle knock, a rattle of the iron crown, a cold dry hiss of escaping shadow

A1-34.ko: 대가 징수의 철퇴 · 쇠사슬 묶인 몸이 받아냄
A1-34.atk: a heavy chain drags and is swung overhead with a groaning whirl, then a spiked iron weight lands with a bone-deep crunch and a cold clank of settling links
A1-34.def: coiled chains wound across its chest take the hit: a loud rattling clang, a deep dense thud, links swaying and jingling to rest

A1-35.ko: 검은 말발굽 짓밟음 · 연기 몸이 흩어졌다 뭉침
A1-35.atk: a ghostly neigh echoes as if from a dream, smoky hooves thunder, then a rearing stomp lands with a deep thud and a burst of violet flame
A1-35.def: the hit sinks into a smoke-black hide: a whooshing scatter of vapour, a muffled snort, the mane flaring as the body pulls back together

A1-41.ko: 사슬만 흔들릴 뿐 · 계약이 가시로 되받음
A1-41.atk: a hooded wraith only drifts and sways: a faint rusty chain clink, a low moan, a cold breath with no real strike
A1-41.def: a translucent body bound in chains hangs firm: a hollow muffled thud, then a sharp snap as invisible contract thorns bite back, chains jangling

A1-42.ko: 흑요석 방패로 쿵 밀침 · 뼈와 검은 돌이 덜걱 울림
A1-42.atk: bones rattle inside heavy plates, a slow step grinds on stone, then an obsidian shield bash lands with a hard glassy clack
A1-42.def: black stone plates take the hit: a deep resonant knock, loose bones clattering inside the hollow armour, a gritty scrape of feet

A1-43.ko: 저울판이 내리누름 · 접시에 충격을 달아 삼킴
A1-43.atk: chains creak as a great beam tips, a bronze pan swings down and lands with a heavy weighing thud, a low gong-like hum settling after
A1-43.def: the strike drops into a hanging pan: a deep bronze clang, chains swaying and groaning, the beam slowly creaking back to balance

SP-A1.ko: 그림자 끊기며 연쇄 마력 · 그림자 없는 몸이 삼킴
SP-A1.atk: a taut tearing sound as a shadow is cut loose from a body, then three rapid rising dark-magic detonations, each deeper than the last, with cracking obsidian and a vast reversed swell
SP-A1.def: no shadow to hit, the blow passes through: a hollow thump of nothing, a soaring wind-like draw, a deep cracked-glass shiver as the strike is swallowed entirely

UN-A1.ko: 피 서약 낙인 베기 · 피 문양 방패
UN-A1.atk: a blade is drawn across a palm, blood drips onto parchment, a hot brand hisses, then a heavy slash cuts and leaves a sizzling stamp-like thud behind
UN-A1.def: glowing blood sigils flare in a circle: a thick humming ward, the strike smacking into it with a wet slap and a ringing seal-like clink

UN-A1-7.ko: 영혼 뽑는 낫 · 영혼 종 울려 막음
UN-A1-7.atk: a hooked blade slips in with a low ghostly draw, a long suction pulls a wisp out with a hollow pop, then a stiff paper folds and snaps shut in a misty palm
UN-A1-7.def: a small cracked bell tolls dully inside its shroud: a hollow chime, a rattling of folded parchment, a soft rush of stolen souls swirling around it

EP-A1-1.atk: curtain fabric swishes, bare feet pivot on boards, twin dark blades whirl with a rising whistling spin, then a sharp crack of a critical cut and the fall of a heavy stage curtain
EP-A1-1.def: it spins away: a rapid sequence of skimming blade scrapes, silk ribbons snapping, a light airy hiss, one clear short steel ring as it lands

EP-A1-2.ko: 도열 쓰러뜨리는 연쇄 · 처형 갑옷 둔중하게 받음
EP-A1-2.atk: a heavy executioner's sword hauled in a wide whistling arc, a first ringing hit, a second deeper hit, a third wet crunch, each followed by a toppling thud and a dark magic hiss
EP-A1-2.def: thick black execution plate: a loud dense clang, hooded cloak heavy with sound, a long metal ring-out and a stubborn deep creak

EP-A1-3.atk: a heavy curtain of shadow is parted with a long cloth whoosh, slow drifting steps echo, then three chained heavy cuts crash down with dark shimmering ring-outs
EP-A1-3.def: a veil of shadow sheaths it: the strike sinks into a thick draping fabric with a deep muffled boom, a soft protective hum washing over like a held breath

PN-A1-C1.ko: 송곳니로 물고 피 빨기 · 아물지 않는 상처
PN-A1-C1.atk: a quick hiss bares fresh fangs, a lunge with a cape flutter, then a sharp bite and a hungry slurp
PN-A1-C1.def: pale skin takes the blow: a soft thud, a pained hiss, a cut that will not close dripping steadily on stone

PN-A1-C2.ko: 협곡 바닥 그림자 솟구침 · 엷어지며 흩어짐
PN-A1-C2.atk: a cold rush of air rises from below, long smoky fingers stretch with a whispery hiss, then close around the foe with a muffled chill
PN-A1-C2.def: the strike passes through a fading wisp: a soft airy sigh, canyon dust settling, a faint whisper lingering

PN-A1-C3.ko: 꿰맨 주먹 내리침 · 실밥 당기며 육중하게 버팀
PN-A1-C3.atk: stitches strain with a creak, a massive grey arm swings with a slow heavy whoosh, then lands with a wet meaty slam and a clank of bolted chains
PN-A1-C3.def: a stitched mound of flesh absorbs it: a deep wet thud, iron staples squeaking, a long groan through a sewn mouth

PN-A1-U1.ko: 피 먹인 검 맹세 · 녹슨 갑주와 검이 맹세로 막음
PN-A1-U1.atk: a blade is wiped with blood and hums low, cold armour creaks, then a straight resolute thrust whistles forward and pierces with a clear wet ring
PN-A1-U1.def: it holds its sword upright and rusted plate takes the rest: a bright steel clang, a grinding of old joints, a dry undead exhale

PN-A1-U2.ko: 저울 동전 짤랑 · 망령이 끌어안은 궤짝이 받음
PN-A1-U2.atk: a ghostly coin pouch jingles and drops into a scale pan, a cold hand slaps a ledger, then a tally spike stabs with a dull metal thunk and coins clinking
PN-A1-U2.def: the blow passes into misty robes and strikes the coin chest it clutches: a deep wooden bong, coins shifting, a hollow sigh

PN-A1-R.ko: 계약서 칼날로 베고 피를 들이켬 · 계약 인장이 막음
PN-A1-R.atk: a folded contract is snapped open, a thin dark blade slides out and slashes, then a low thirsty inhale as a thin trickle of blood is drawn back toward the blade
PN-A1-R.def: a blood-stamped contract held up like a shield: a papery shield-like slap, a hot seal sizzling, a wound-open drip that keeps tapping

PN-A1-E.ko: 두고 온 것을 찾는 연쇄 · 비어있는 몸이 무너짐
PN-A1-E.atk: a low reversed swell opens like a curtain, two deep dark-magic strikes land in a double-hit chain, each trailed by an empty hollow echo like something missing and a lingering drip
PN-A1-E.def: its hollow torso rings like an empty vessel: a resonant boom, a slow draining hiss, a patter of blood that never seems to heal

UP-A1-09.ko: 여왕 거미가 그림자 실로 감아 물어뜯음 · 큰 등딱지로 받음
UP-A1-09.atk: many long legs skitter fast over rock with dry clicks, thick shadow silk whips out in several twanging lines, then huge twin fangs sink in with a deep wet crunch and a venom hiss
UP-A1-09.def: a broad glossy carapace takes the blow with a heavy chitin knock, long legs creak as they fold in, and a web of thick strands stretches and twangs around her

UP-A1-11.ko: 선봉 군기 돌격 · 방패 없이 몸으로 맞고 비틀
UP-A1-11.atk: a short war horn-like grunt, thudding boots charge, then a heavy double-handed sword hews with a wide whistle and a punishing iron slam
UP-A1-11.def: no shield and worn leather only: the blow lands with a heavy flesh-and-hide thud, tattered vanguard cloth snapping, a harsh grunt as boots skid backward in gravel

UP-A1-15.ko: 공중에 뜬 마검이 세 번 베며 피를 마심 · 칼날이 울며 쳐냄
UP-A1-15.atk: a cursed floating greatsword hums hungrily, whips through the air with three rising metallic whistles, then bites deep with a wet slurping hiss as the dark steel drinks
UP-A1-15.def: the cursed blade spins edge-on to parry: a deep resonant steel ring, a dark vibrating hum along the blood-slick metal, red droplets pattering onto stone

UP-A1-18.ko: 거대한 그림자 짐승이 덮쳐 물어 찢음 · 연기 털이 흩어졌다 뭉침
UP-A1-18.atk: a deep rumbling growl, a heavy padded lunge, then massive jaws snap shut with a bone-crunching bite and a tearing shake in a burst of smoky snarls
UP-A1-18.def: a huge body of black smoke fur takes the hit: a heavy padded thump, a long hiss of scattering smoke, a menacing growl as the shape gathers back

UP-A1-23.ko: 거대한 낫이 허공을 갈라 베어냄 · 뼈 손과 낫자루가 둔탁히 막음
UP-A1-23.atk: a towering reaper raises a massive scythe with a rattling bone creak, sweeps it in a wide cold whoosh, then delivers a clean reaping slice followed by a hollow shadow hush
UP-A1-23.def: bony hands thrust the iron-bound scythe shaft across the blow: a heavy wooden-and-steel knock, rattling ribs beneath dark cloth, chains clinking against stone

MA-01.ko: 그림자 칼날이 스치고 소름 끼치는 속삭임
MA-01.cast: two thin shadow blades slip past with cold airy swishes, a chill breathy whisper creeps close behind, then armour rattles in a shivering tremor as a weapon trembles in a loosened grip

MA-04.ko: 흘린 피가 땅밑에서 울리다 한꺼번에 터짐
MA-04.cast: a low heartbeat thrums beneath the ground and grows louder with each beat, a dark resonant hum swells, then it bursts upward in one sharp crimson crack into the strongest foe

SA1-01.ko: 저울이 기울며 소각장에서 죽은 자가 일어섬
SA1-01.cast: a deep scale-beam creaks and tips with a heavy iron clank, cold ash stirs with a low rushing wind, then bones and armour scrape together as a fallen warrior rises with a hollow groan

SA1-02.ko: 그림자 손이 적을 움켜쥐어 이쪽으로 끌어옴
SA1-02.cast: a shadow stretches across the ground with a cold silky slither, a huge hand clamps shut with a muffled crunch, then something heavy is dragged across stone toward us with a long grinding scrape

MA-05.ko: 피 얹어 가장 무거운 자 들림
MA-05.cast: blood drips onto a metal scale pan with a clink, the beam creaks and tilts, then the heavy side is hoisted away with a chain-hoist rattle and a final deep boom

MC-05.ko: 안개 속에서 적이 제 전우를 베어 버림
MC-05.cast: a sweet dark mist breathes out with a hollow whisper and warped echoing laughter, a confused snarl, then a blade strikes the wrong target with a sickening metallic clang and a shocked gasp

SA1-04.ko: 거울 속 그림자가 걸어 나와 적의 모습으로 섬
SA1-04.cast: a dark mirror surface ripples with a glassy shimmer, a reflected footstep echoes from inside, then a shadowy double steps out with a crystalline crack and a cold distorted breath

MA-09.cast: a clawed hand closes with a dry creak, heavy plate armour groans and ignites from within with a low deep roaring fire, metal hissing and ticking red-hot as the flames burn on

SA1-06.ko: 아군이 손바닥 그어 피를 칼에 먹이고, 그 피가 적 줄을 꿰뚫음
SA1-06.cast: several quick blade cuts hiss across palms, blood drips and hisses onto steel with a hungry sizzle, then a heavy crimson surge rips forward through one enemy after another with deep wet impacts

MA-16.ko: 피 한 잔 나눠 마시고 힘 솟음
MA-16.cast: many cups clink together, a thick blood gulp, then a rising swell of dark energy builds under heavy breathing, ending in a roaring surge that crackles through every weapon

RA1-1.cast: a single deep bell tolls, a heavy parchment is stamped with a thud, then a total silence swells and everything collapses at once in one enormous cracking boom with a long dying rumble

NA1-1.cast: a shadow stretches along the floor like torn ribbon, a sly snatch rustles and pulls the card across with a papery drag, then a soft fabric flick and a closing fist of dark

HA1-1.cast: a quick friendly clap of hands, a soft rustle of parchment slipped from a sleeve, a cloth sliding swap, then a tiny coin-like tick and a smooth card flip

HA1-2.cast: a fingertip taps a card with a faint dry scratch, a cold breathy whisper hisses close to the ear, then a small shivering tremble like chattering teeth fades into quiet

HA1-3.cast: a blood-wax sigil presses down with a soft wet squelch, sticky rot creeps across parchment with a slow crackling ooze, then a damp spreading hiss fans out to the neighbouring cards

US-A1-1.ko: 피 한 방울에 목숨 둘 내려감
US-A1-1.cast: a single blood drop lands on a vast brass scale with a muted ring, the beam sways in total silence, then two heavy weights crash down with deep dull thuds and a long hush

PS-A1-1.cast: a draining reversed sucking whoosh pulls glowing strands out of two foes, a paper-thin tearing, then the stolen energy pours into an ally with a warm swelling thrum

PS-A1-2.ko: 녹슨 족쇄 철컥 · 끈적한 부패가 번짐
PS-A1-2.cast: a rusted shackle snaps shut with a heavy grinding clank, a wet sticky rot oozes out of the iron, then a slow bubbling decay seeps outward to either side with a damp hiss

RS-A1-1.cast: blood is pulled from a hand into a dark spear with a thick congealing squelch and a crystalline ring, then it launches with a hard whistle and runs through its target with a deep wet impact

RS-A1-2.cast: a dark veil unfurls with a heavy cloth whoosh, a long sucking drain pulls from the front line, then a soft heartbeat-like pulse thrums as the ally swells with borrowed strength

RS-A1-3.cast: taut violet threads hum and pull tight with a stretched creak, a low droning pulse takes hold of a mind, then slow heavy footsteps turn around and march back across the field

US-A1-2.cast: a thin parchment unrolls with a brittle crackle, a pen-scratch burns a mark, then a sharp strike hits a foe while a surging dark swell rises behind the allies with a sharp metallic crack

CS-A1.cast: a spell is choked to a dead hush with a sucking click, a thin hollow ghostly breath glides inward, then a big body sags with a heavy creaking slump and a fading heartbeat

I2-3.equip: a dagger slides from a sleeve with a silk whisper, a tiny sharp clip locks it to a belt, then one quick test throw whistles and sticks into wood with a twang

IA1-1.equip: a thumb is pricked, blood drips on a small parchment charm, the paper is pressed with a wet stamp, and it settles with a faint warm hum and a thin brass clink

IA1-2.ko: 흑요석 단검 · 벤 자리에서 피가 계속 흐름
IA1-2.equip: a glassy obsidian dagger is slid into a sheath with a smooth click, a faint tick of stone on leather, then a thin wet drip that keeps falling drop by drop

IA1-3.equip: a rag doll is stuffed with a dry rustle of hair, a needle pricks through cloth with a small pop, then a tiny shrill creaking squeak of thread rings on every poke

IA1-4.equip: a hollow mask lifts with a hollow porcelain knock, slips over a face with a leather strap snap, and the room's sound is sucked to a hush with a reversed hiss

S3-1.equip: a heavy metal seal is pressed into hot wax with a wet crunch and sizzle, then a dark silky whoosh slides sideways like a shadow stepping aside, and a brass clink settles
